snippet.title: Yatzi. Game for Switch, PS4 & PS5. Official English video.
snippet.description:
Skillful combination is half the batlle! 
It's quite tricky to roll a YATZI: Roll five dice with the same number in three tries. This classic dice game thrills players thanks to its simple game rules and exciting gameplay. You can’t be sure who has the most points until the very end.
